_comment: Spell NAMES (as they appear in mythicsim-forever-engine/data/spells.jsonl) that Forte_Rogue tracks. gen_spell_data.py resolves each to its highest-rank spell ID + current duration/cooldown data. Names with no match in a given build are reported by the generator, not silently dropped -- re-check them after a mythicsim-forever-engine pull. Forever notes: the rogue base kit includes spells Cata-era rogues would not know -- Shadowstep (30 s core mobility), Between the Eyes (stun, shares kidney-shot category 270), Blade Flurry, Premeditation, Main Gauche, Redirect, Revealed Flaw, Ghostly Strike, Riposte, Rebuke, Blade Dance -- and the poison line has Forever-flavoured names (Atrophic, Sebacious, Venomhide, Occult, Glimpse of Madness, Blood Corruption). Vanish/Blind/Evasion/Sprint carry 5-min category cooldowns; Stealth sits in the shared stealth category 38 with druid Prowl; there is NO Shadow Dance, Shadowstrike and Mutilate have no cooldown fields in this build. Adrenaline Rush/Rebuke/Vigor name rows collide with pet/paladin/general rows; the generator picks the highest-rank row globally, fine for name-keyed cast tracking. Poisons are tracked at the highest craftable rank name only. T1 (2026-11-02, docs/class-port.md 6.1 + PLAN 11.1 Q1/Q6 rulings): the reference's CAST spells are added -- buffs += Crimson Tempest, the Rank-1 poison lines Mind-numbing Poison and Deadly Poison (the list has always carried the ranked Forever names too) and Envenom; cooldowns += the family-less Q6 Dismantle row. Envenom (399968) and Dismantle (442206) carry no window on this build -- pinned in Forte_Cooldown/tests/test_tracked_set.lua. No §6.1 name of this class is a proc/passive, so _deferred_H7 is empty. Wave I-2b (2026-11-03, upstream-data §5.1): cooldowns += Setup (13983/15250, the ICD-gated Riposte-companion proc, 0 window -- the proc layer, H7 design, keeps its 1 s ICD) and _deferred_H7 += the post-9 net-new names Shank, Death Mark, Poised (dev notes post 9: the client has only value-less Classic rows 15250/1325756-8, Poised has no client name at all -- ids at opening are a launch probe). Wave I-3 H7 (2026-11-03, upstream-data §5.1/§7.3, fx-worker I3e): Shank and Death Mark MOVED OUT of _deferred_H7 into [cooldowns] -- the client-data criterion is met: the 70707 store's Names table carries Shank at 15248/15617 and Death Mark at 1316709/1325756/7/8 (family-less, no Levels/Cooldowns/Misc rows -- verified in the raw store at 6e69a7f4), so both land as 70707-sourced {id, name} shell rows (the index-shell law, the Mesmerize 24594 shape): a NAME the generator can key, no window -- post 9's 10 s cd / 6 s mark are text-only values, the launch-day probe rows. Poised STAYS deferred: no Names row at all, no id to key (upstream-data §5 row 24).

Berserking.reason: all four 70790 rows (20554/23505/24378/1286304) are value-less name shells (no Cooldowns row), so the bare-row tiebreak rides the arbitrary max-id shell; 20554 is the id measured 180 s on the live client (tools/overrides_devnotes_2026-11-03.json, owner session 2026-11-06; review-10 M2/m4)

Rapid Regeneration.reason: the store's 1260270 is a value-less name shell (no Cooldowns row); the id is pinned to record the measured subject of the 180 s dev-notes fact (tools/overrides_devnotes_2026-11-03.json, owner session 2026-11-06; review-10 M2/m4)

Venom.reason: two family-8 rows share the name: 1329328 is the level-30 passive talent (no duration), 1310703 is the 6 s aura Shank casts with the talent (docs/research/live-rogue-2026-11-09.md section 8; store Misc['1310703'].DurationMs = 6000)
